dialogues.speaker: Gaiman
dialogues.text: I'm a novelist. Doing some research for my latest work.

dialogues.speaker: Gaiman
dialogues.text: I originally came to Liyue looking for the author of A Legend of Sword, but then I happened across some works on the rise and fall of the Guhua Clan...

dialogues.speaker: Gaiman
dialogues.text: I thought: "what a great topic to write about!" So, I've decided that I'm going to kick-start my writing career with a swashbuckling Guhua masterpiece!

dialogues.speaker: Gaiman
dialogues.text: Chapter One opens with the grand master fighting the dragon! Did you know this was the very spot where he was standing...
